title: Rule document frontmatter
description: Frontmatter for a rule document in docs/code/. The prose authority is docs/__meta__/code.md section 2; this schema is its machine-checkable half.

name.description: Kebab-case. Must match the filename minus .md, which the checker verifies separately.

allOf.$comment: The trigger clause naming the situations this document governs.

type.description: The kind of rule. meta is reserved for the format specifications in docs/__meta__/.

scope.description: global, or pkg:<name> naming a package by its full import path, starting lorecraft_core or lorecraft: snake_case, dotted for nesting.
